name: R2R
tagline: Closing the books, reporting the numbers and evidencing the controls behind every period end.
pickerIntro: Period close, journals, intercompany, group reporting and controls activities run by the R2R team.

context.label: Solutions
context.text: Period close runs in SAP ECC with BlackLine for manual journals and AJD auto-postings, Nintex for NTI intercompany requests, ERH for group reporting and IRM for control attestation, supported by Power BI dashboards for the month-end timetable, inventory data quality and the BSI Pack.

context.label: Automation
context.text: Documented automation includes BlackLine AJD postings (Concur T&E, China accruals, ABACUS clinical accruals), Python scripts for SAP data extraction (VAT, FX, BSR, payroll evidence), Power Automate email approvals, the Speedy Bot SAP-to-ERH reconciliation and Excel macros for divestment extracts and distribution cycles.

context.label: AI
context.text: SubZero is listed as the AI opportunity for manual journal preparation in BlackLine. No other deployed AI capability is documented, though the team asks whether the Speedy Bot could take over the quarterly ERH 101 and 102 new-line check.

context.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
context.text: R2R works with GFR, Embedded Finance, the Middle Office, the GFS Process Towers, P2P, HR and payroll providers, SAP IT and DMT, the Capex and Clinical Finance Warsaw teams, FP&A, GBS, FCCG and Compliance, and external auditors across close, reporting and controls.

processes.title: Period close communication
processes.purpose:
Each month the R2R team prepares stakeholders for period close by communicating the month-end timetable to every market and by reviewing the briefing notes published by GFR so that any key accounting items are considered as part of the close.

The outputs are the communication of period-end activities and the timetable, a shared briefing note summary, and an acknowledgement of the briefing note sent back to GFR. The audience is GFR, Embedded Finance, the Middle Offices and Transactional Finance.
processes.cadence: Monthly, ahead of period close, in accordance with the global close calendar.

stages.detail: 1. On a monthly basis, the team will communicate the month-end timetable to each market, highlighting the key closing timeline across critical activities in accordance to global close calendar.
challenges: Manual effort is required to prepare and send out the monthly timetable to stakeholders via email.

processes.title: AP and AR regrouping
processes.purpose:
At the end of each reporting period, after the AP and AR subledgers are closed, the team verifies vendor and customer accounts to determine whether a reclassification is required. Customers with a credit balance are reclassified to vendors and vendors with a debit balance are reclassified to customers, in both cases through journals to GL accounts defined solely for these month-end reclassification postings.

The process is executed through specific SAP t-codes. The outcome is that the regrouping is posted and the reporting position for both customers and vendors is recorded accurately for GFS Middle Office, Embedded Finance and GFR, supporting ERH reporting in compliance with IFRS.

processes.title: VAT reclassification
processes.purpose:
At period end the team determines whether each entity's input and output VAT nets to a payable or a recoverable position and posts a clearing entry so that VAT is presented on a net basis.

The posting transfers balances from the input VAT/GST recoverable accounts (17120100 and 17120101) and the output VAT/GST payable accounts (22310100 and 22310101) to either 17120300 Net VAT Recoverable Domestic or 22310400 Net VAT Payable Domestic, depending on whether the net balance is payable or receivable. The result is that VAT is captured in either a net payable or a net recoverable position for the Middle Office, TDT and Embedded Finance.
processes.cadence: At period end, once the VAT balances are captured in SAP; approval is obtained before the clearing entry is posted.

stages.detail: 1. Generate F.01 to determine position of Net Payables/ Recoverable for Input/ Output VAT amount.
challenges: Manual data extraction from SAP and email approval by market.

stages.description: Generate F.01 to determine the net payable or recoverable position for the input and output VAT amounts captured in SAP.

stages.title: Run the VAT clearing test run and send for review
stages.detail: 2. Execute t-code S_ALR_87012357 for VAT clearing - test run and send to approver for review.
stages.displayTitle: Run the VAT clearing test run and send for review
stages.description: Execute t-code S_ALR_87012357 for VAT clearing as a test run and send the result to the approver for review by email.

stages.title: Post the net VAT clearing entry
stages.detail: 3. Once approved, to post net off liability / assets to VAT clearing account via SAP t-code SM35. This process will transfer transactions from the following GL accounts 17120100 Input VAT/GST Recoverable 17120101 Input VAT/GST Recoverable Manual Posting 22310100 Output VAT/GST Payable 22310101 Output VAT/GST Payable Manual Posting to either of the following GL accounts dependent on whether the net balance is payable or receivable 17120300 Net VAT Recoverable Domestic 22310400 Net VAT Payable Domestic
stages.displayTitle: Post the net VAT clearing entry
stages.description:
Once approved, post the net liability or asset to the VAT clearing account via t-code SM35.

The posting moves balances from 17120100 Input VAT/GST Recoverable, 17120101 Input VAT/GST Recoverable Manual Posting, 22310100 Output VAT/GST Payable and 22310101 Output VAT/GST Payable Manual Posting to 17120300 Net VAT Recoverable Domestic or 22310400 Net VAT Payable Domestic, depending on whether the net balance is payable or receivable.

stages.title: Verify the posting and hand over
stages.detail: 4. Re-run F.01 to ensure the posting posted and reflected correctly. | VAT is captured either in net payables or recoverable position | Middle Office TDTEmbedded Finance
stages.displayTitle: Verify the posting and hand over
stages.description:
Re-run F.01 to confirm that the posting has been made and is reflected correctly.

VAT is now captured in either a net payable or a net recoverable position for the Middle Office, TDT and Embedded Finance.

processes.title: Payroll interface load
processes.purpose:
The post-payroll process takes the payroll files submitted by the payroll providers through a simulation posting in SAP, resolves any errors, and then authorises the production run so that payroll is posted correctly. Parties involved are GBS Payroll Services, local HR, the external payroll service providers and SAP IT, with the R2R team coordinating error resolution and authorisation.

The outcome is a validated payroll file interfaced into SAP, with the SAP payroll data extracted and shared with HR, Embedded Finance and the Middle Office.

Requests originate from the Middle Office and Embedded Finance.

Once approved, the NTI flows either to automated processing in BlackLine or to manual processing by the Intercompany Delivery Team, and AP and AR are posted in SAP for both parties. The outcome is an NTI raised and approved in Nintex and posted into SAP for both the selling and purchasing entities, serving the Middle Office, Embedded Finance and the entities themselves.

The outcome is that the SAP modules are closed, the correct status is reflected on the R2R KPI dashboard, and Global KPI slides are prepared for the monthly R2R governance meeting, serving the GFS Process Towers, Embedded Finance and Global R2R.

processes.title: SAP and ERH resubmission
processes.purpose:
When a GFS Process Tower or Embedded Finance requests a resubmission, the R2R team assesses materiality and impact against the global standard, and the R2R regional head approves the ServiceNow ticket. The impacted SAP modules are reopened, correction entries are posted via BlackLine journal or directly in SAP, the period is checked for unauthorised postings and closed again, and the ERH resubmission follows.

For ERH, the impacted entity is demoted to Level 1, the data is updated from SAP or corrected manually in ERH, and the entity is promoted back to Level 2 and signed off. The outcome is a completed resubmission with data ready for group statutory reporting by GFR and a posting period that is closed.
